source.inspection: All page text extracted; all 65 rendered pages inspected across five private contact sheets; variant-critical descriptions checked in full.

pages.title: Cover
pages.reviewNote: Brand/cover photography; no instructional exercise mapping.

pages.title: Table of Contents
pages.reviewNote: Section index, not an exercise.

pages.title: Introduction
pages.reviewNote: Publisher context; no redistribution grant found.

pages.title: Functional Training Arms / General Exercise Guidelines
pages.reviewNote: Machine/generic exercise guidance; not a new Setline prescription.

pages.title: Chest section divider
pages.reviewNote: Decorative anatomical/athlete photo, not a movement demonstration.

pages.title: Bench Press
pages.observedVariation: Seated linked-lever chest press on the BODYCRAFT multigym.
pages.reviewNote: Machine chest press only; never a barbell bench press.

pages.title: Cable Bench Press
pages.observedVariation: Back-supported seated two-handle cable press.
pages.reviewNote: No dedicated seated cable chest-press ID; do not assign to barbell/DB press.

pages.title: Converging Bench Press
pages.observedVariation: Seated cable chest press with hands converging.
pages.reviewNote: Convergence/cable variation is distinct from an unspecified lever chest press.

pages.title: Incline Bench Press
pages.observedVariation: Linked-lever press with the BODYCRAFT adjustable seat/body orientation.
pages.reviewNote: Only an incline machine variant; not incline barbell or dumbbell press.

pages.title: Cable Incline Bench Press
pages.observedVariation: Seated cable press with an upward diagonal path.
pages.reviewNote: No dedicated seated incline cable-press ID.

pages.title: Converging Incline Press
pages.observedVariation: Seated upward cable press with converging hands.
pages.reviewNote: Do not reuse for an incline dumbbell or barbell press.

pages.title: Decline Bench Press
pages.observedVariation: BODYCRAFT lever press with decline-relative body orientation.
pages.reviewNote: No current decline lever-press ID.

pages.title: Cable Decline Bench Press
pages.observedVariation: Back-supported decline-direction cable press.
pages.reviewNote: Not a current flat or incline press.

pages.title: Converging Decline Bench Press
pages.observedVariation: Decline-direction cable press with hands converging.
pages.reviewNote: No current exact variant.

pages.title: Self Stabilizing Chest Press
pages.observedVariation: Seated cable press without back support.
pages.reviewNote: Unsupported seated trunk demand differs from supported machine chest press.

pages.title: Cable Pec Fly
pages.observedVariation: Back-supported seated/reclined cable fly.
pages.reviewNote: Current Cable Chest Fly guide is standing split-stance; seated image must not be assigned automatically.

pages.title: Cable Incline Fly
pages.observedVariation: Supported seated cable fly with an upward closing arc.
pages.reviewNote: Current standing fly does not identify this supported incline variant.

pages.title: Cable Low Fly
pages.observedVariation: Upright seated cable low-to-high fly.
pages.reviewNote: Not the current standing chest-height fly.

pages.title: Shoulders section divider
pages.reviewNote: Decorative section photo, not a movement demonstration.

pages.title: Shoulder Press
pages.observedVariation: Seated overhead linked-lever press.
pages.reviewNote: Only a compatible machine setup; not dumbbells or a barbell.

pages.title: Cable Shoulder Press
pages.observedVariation: Back-supported two-handle overhead cable press.
pages.reviewNote: Not a dumbbell shoulder press or generic lever-machine photograph.

pages.title: Converging Shoulder Press
pages.observedVariation: Seated overhead cable press with converging hands.
pages.reviewNote: No dedicated converging cable shoulder-press ID.

pages.title: Cable Lateral Raise
pages.observedVariation: Seated bilateral low-cable lateral raise.
pages.reviewNote: Current default is standing one arm; use PDF25 rather than this seated bilateral variation.

pages.title: Cable Front Raise
pages.observedVariation: Seated bilateral low-cable front raise.
pages.reviewNote: Front flexion is not lateral abduction.

pages.title: Standing Cable Lateral Raise
pages.observedVariation: Standing single-arm low-cable lateral raise.
pages.reviewNote: Matches standing cable variant; cable line and working arm must remain visible.

pages.title: Standing Front Raise
pages.observedVariation: Standing low-pulley straight-bar front raise.
pages.reviewNote: No current cable front-raise ID; not a lateral raise.

pages.title: Upright Row
pages.observedVariation: Standing low-cable straight-bar upright row.
pages.reviewNote: Not a horizontal back row or lateral raise.

pages.title: Shrugs
pages.observedVariation: Standing low-cable straight-bar shrug.
pages.reviewNote: No current shrug ID.

pages.title: External Rotator
pages.observedVariation: Standing dynamic cable external rotation with elbow by the ribs.
pages.reviewNote: Cable dynamic variant only; band and timed external-rotation-isometric require separate verification.

pages.title: Internal Rotator
pages.observedVariation: Standing cable internal rotation with elbow by the ribs.
pages.reviewNote: Opposite rotation direction to external-rotation.

pages.title: Back section divider
pages.reviewNote: Decorative section photo, not a movement demonstration.

pages.title: Lat Pull Down
pages.observedVariation: Seated wide pronated-grip high-pulley pulldown to the upper chest.
pages.reviewNote: Not the distinct neutral-grip lat-pulldown ID.

pages.title: Low Cable Row
pages.observedVariation: Floor-seated unsupported low-cable row with braced feet.
pages.reviewNote: Floor and handle variant must be disclosed; not chest-supported-row.

pages.title: Mid Row
pages.observedVariation: Seated linked-lever row facing the adjustable front pad.
pages.reviewNote: Potential supported machine variant: verify sustained chest-pad contact and handle path; not bench/DB version or unsupported cable row.

pages.title: One Arm Row
pages.observedVariation: Bent-over single-arm cable row with the free hand supported on the seat.
pages.reviewNote: Cable resistance, support and trunk angle must match; not one-arm-dumbbell-row.

pages.title: Front Lat Pullover
pages.observedVariation: Standing high-cable straight-arm pullover/pulldown.
pages.reviewNote: No dedicated straight-arm cable pulldown ID; not a bent-elbow pulldown.

pages.title: Seated Cable Mid Row
pages.observedVariation: Seat-supported position with unsupported trunk and mid-pulley bar row.
pages.reviewNote: Different cable height/handle to PDF33; no chest support.

pages.title: Self Stabilizing Mid Row
pages.observedVariation: Standing unsupported mid-cable bilateral row.
pages.reviewNote: Current Seated Cable Row is seated, not standing.

pages.title: Arms section divider
pages.reviewNote: Decorative section photo, not a movement demonstration.

pages.title: Cable Arm Curl
pages.observedVariation: Seated low-cable handle curl.
pages.reviewNote: Current Cable Curl guide is standing; generic Biceps Curl does not establish this seated cable variant.

pages.title: Standing Bar Curl
pages.observedVariation: Standing low-cable straight-bar curl.
pages.reviewNote: Cable Curl is compatible with bar selection; Biceps Curl only if explicitly configured for cable, never a DB image substitute.

pages.title: Overhead Biceps Curl
pages.observedVariation: Seated facing-machine high-cable curl with upper arms raised.
pages.reviewNote: Not a standard standing low-cable curl.

pages.title: Arm Curl From Mid Pulley
pages.observedVariation: Seated cable curl toward the face from a mid pulley.
pages.reviewNote: No current exact mid-pulley face-height curl variant.

pages.title: Triceps Pushdown
pages.observedVariation: Standing high-cable straight-bar pushdown.
pages.reviewNote: Only straight-bar configuration; existing rope alias needs a separate rope photograph.

pages.title: Triceps Extension
pages.observedVariation: Seated mid-cable bar extension with upper arms near horizontal.
pages.reviewNote: Not current overhead rope extension or downward rope pushdown.

pages.title: Triceps Extension From High Pulley
pages.observedVariation: Seated forward-lean high-cable bar extension, upper arms near horizontal.
pages.reviewNote: Do not label this as the current standing upper-arms-overhead rope variation.

pages.title: Triceps Kickback
pages.observedVariation: Bent-over cable kickback with one hand supporting the trunk.
pages.reviewNote: No cable triceps-kickback ID in the current catalogue.

pages.title: Core section divider
pages.reviewNote: Decorative section photo; text layer also contains stray CHEST label.

pages.title: Ab Crunch
pages.observedVariation: Seated high-cable strap crunch with the strap over the shoulders.
pages.reviewNote: Current Cable Crunch is kneeling with a rope; not the same setup.

pages.title: Reverse Crunch (Seated Knee Raise)
pages.observedVariation: Seated supported-hands knee raise.
pages.reviewNote: Neither the current floor reverse crunch nor a hanging knee raise.

pages.title: Oblique Twist
pages.observedVariation: Standing cable-resisted trunk rotation.
pages.reviewNote: Dynamic rotation is not Pallof anti-rotation or an isometric hold.

pages.title: Side Bends
pages.observedVariation: Standing unilateral cable-loaded lateral trunk flexion.
pages.reviewNote: Dynamic lateral bending is not a suitcase carry or anti-lateral-flexion hold.

pages.title: Legs section divider
pages.reviewNote: Decorative section photo, not a movement demonstration.

pages.title: Leg Extension
pages.observedVariation: Seated lever/pad knee extension.
pages.reviewNote: Confirm knee pivot and pad layout; no claim that this is the athlete's exact gym machine.

pages.title: Standing Leg Curl
pages.observedVariation: Supported standing unilateral lever/pad knee curl.
pages.reviewNote: The current broad Leg Curl ID has seated/lying aliases; this standing variant is not identified by either.

pages.title: Seated Leg Curl
pages.observedVariation: BODYCRAFT Elite seated lever/pad knee curl.
pages.reviewNote: Explicitly seated Elite-model variant; do not use for a lying leg curl or imply identical commercial machine.

pages.title: Leg Press
pages.observedVariation: Seated horizontal BODYCRAFT optional leg-press attachment.
pages.reviewNote: Not a 45-degree sled; equipment-specific caption and choice required.

pages.title: Calf Raise
pages.observedVariation: Near-straight-leg ankle press on the seated leg-press attachment.
pages.reviewNote: Neither standing calf raise nor bent-knee seated calf raise; also dynamic, not an isometric.

pages.title: Hip Adduction
pages.observedVariation: Standing ankle-cuff cable hip adduction.
pages.reviewNote: Not a seated pad-loaded adductor machine.

pages.title: Hip Abduction
pages.observedVariation: Standing ankle-cuff cable hip abduction.
pages.reviewNote: Neither a side-lying clamshell nor a lateral band walk.

pages.title: Glute Kick
pages.observedVariation: Supported standing ankle-cuff low-cable hip extension.
pages.reviewNote: Cable cuff and supported standing variant align; not a hip-thrust photograph.

pages.title: Sports Specific / Functional introduction
pages.reviewNote: Sport section text/club background, not a separate exercise demonstration.

pages.title: Golf Swing
pages.observedVariation: Cable-resisted golf swing pattern.
pages.reviewNote: Not a medicine-ball rotational throw or volleyball drill.

pages.title: Tennis Swing
pages.observedVariation: Cable-resisted tennis forehand/backhand swing.
pages.reviewNote: Not a rotational medicine-ball throw.

pages.title: Baseball Pitch
pages.observedVariation: Cable-resisted single-arm pitching action.
pages.reviewNote: Not a two-handed medicine-ball slam, overhead throw or actual volleyball spike.
